n7bdbd688c4.headline: Bank of England holds interest rates at 3.75 but says inflation still to rise
n7bdbd688c4.summary: The Bank of England kept interest rates at 3.75 per cent. Policymakers said a recent fall in energy prices means they no longer expect inflation to reach the peak they had forecast in April.
n7bdbd688c4.why: The Bank of England sets the UK Bank Rate, which shapes sterling, gilt yields and borrowing costs across the British economy.
n7bdbd688c4.why_moved: The decision was held steady, while the central bank's updated inflation view, citing lower energy prices, changed expectations for the path of inflation.

n4153d0aa2a.headline: ‘Iran just basically put its wish list into this’: The Trump-Iran agreement gives Iran a free pass on nuclear treaty violations pending final deal
n4153d0aa2a.summary: Critics say the Trump-Iran memorandum gives Iran leeway on nuclear treaty violations while a final deal is pending. The minimum requirement is that Iran downblend its highly enriched uranium, which an expert calls reversible.
n4153d0aa2a.why: Iran's nuclear programme and sanctions status influence global oil supply expectations and Middle East geopolitical risk.

n21f150f905.headline: Migrant intake dips as anti-immigration voices swell
n21f150f905.summary: Net overseas migration is slowly falling, but figures remain above Labor's forecasts and the sharp cuts demanded by anti-immigration voices. Migration affects population growth and labour supply.
n21f150f905.why: Net migration drives population growth, labour supply and housing demand, which feed into Australia's economic outlook.

n01e51fba4a.headline: RBM flags investor risks as Equity Fund debuts
n01e51fba4a.summary: Stakeholders warn that growing interest in collective investment schemes exposes first-time investors in Malawi to risk. The warning comes as the Equity Fund debuts.
n01e51fba4a.why: Collective investment schemes pool retail savings into funds, and investor protection rules shape confidence in local capital markets.

n15a8934f62.headline: Indonesia to launch B50 biodiesel policy on July 1 to cut imports
n15a8934f62.summary: Indonesia is on track to implement the B50 biodiesel policy on July 1, 2026. The aim is to significantly reduce imports of diesel fuel.
n15a8934f62.why: Biodiesel blending mandates reduce demand for imported diesel and shift demand toward palm-based fuels.

n66e9851340.headline: Living wage must be a priority in upcoming budget - FTUC
n66e9851340.summary: The Fiji Trades Union Congress says a clear plan to introduce a living wage should be a key feature of the 2026/2027 National Budget.
n66e9851340.why: Minimum and living wage policy affects labour costs for employers and household incomes in the economy.

n46dfb60408.headline: Foreign Investment in Uzbekistan Gains Strong Momentum
n46dfb60408.summary: Foreign direct investment is expanding in Uzbekistan as a key tool for sustainable economic growth. The country is increasing capital inflows, according to the report.
n46dfb60408.why: Foreign direct investment brings capital, technology and jobs, and its trends shape a country's growth outlook for investors.

n60ef145a4f.headline: Pyshny allows for PrivatBank, Oschadbank privatization
n60ef145a4f.summary: National Bank of Ukraine Governor Andriy Pyshny did not rule out privatising the state-owned PrivatBank and Oschadbank. He said any such decision should be part of a broader state banking strategy.
n60ef145a4f.why: PrivatBank and Oschadbank are major state-owned Ukrainian lenders. Privatisation plans affect the structure, governance and value of the country's banking sector.

n4749567a28.headline: At least 12 tankers pass through Strait of Hormuz within hours of Trump’s Iran deal, data shows
n4749567a28.summary: At least 12 major energy tankers sailed through the Strait of Hormuz within hours of Trump signing a deal with Iran to end the conflict. The data showed.
n4749567a28.why: The Strait of Hormuz carries a large share of the world's seaborne oil. Disruption or reopening of the route directly affects crude supply expectations and prices.
n4749567a28.why_moved: Tanker traffic through the Strait of Hormuz resumed within hours of the signed deal, easing fears of supply disruption.

n472f2033d6.headline: FILA Group sells 7% stake in DOMS Industries for ₹934 crore
n472f2033d6.summary: FILA Group sold a 7% stake in DOMS Industries for ₹934 crore. SBI and Axis Mutual Funds increased their holdings in the company.
n472f2033d6.why: DOMS Industries is an Indian stationery and art supplies maker listed on the National Stock Exchange. Large shareholder transactions can affect share supply and investor sentiment.

n29e45f727e.headline: FILA Group sells 7% stake in DOMS Industries for Rs 934 crore
n29e45f727e.summary: Italian multinational FILA Group sold a 7 percent stake in DOMS Industries for Rs 934 crore. SBI Mutual Fund and Axis Mutual Fund bought a combined 2.13 percent stake for Rs 285 crore.
n29e45f727e.why: DOMS Industries is an Indian stationery and art-supplies maker, and block stake sales by major shareholders can shift its shareholder base and trading supply.

n8200e9b096.headline: Stock markets end higher for 5th day in a row on lower crude prices, optimism over US-Iran deal
n8200e9b096.summary: Stock markets ended higher for a fifth day in a row on lower crude prices and optimism over a US-Iran deal. InterGlobe Aviation, Trent, Bharat Electronics, NTPC, SBI and HDFC Bank were among the biggest winners.
n8200e9b096.why: The BSE Sensex is the benchmark index of the Bombay Stock Exchange, tracking large Indian companies. Lower crude prices help oil-importing economies such as India.
n8200e9b096.why_moved: Lower crude prices and optimism over a US-Iran deal supported Indian equities. Airlines and banks were among the biggest gainers.

n1a51432e92.headline: The price of jet fuel is falling, but don't expect airfares to follow any time soon
n1a51432e92.summary: The average price of jet fuel has fallen to its lowest level since the start of the war with Iran. Aviation experts say airfares are likely to stay high for now.
n1a51432e92.why: Jet fuel is a major airline cost, so its price shifts affect airline margins and ticket prices.

n2e76b6782d.headline: Trump confirms Apple-Intel partnership to make chips: Will it affect smartphone prices? | Company Business News
n2e76b6782d.summary: US President Donald Trump said on Thursday that Apple has agreed to work with Intel to design and manufacture its chips in the United States. The report questions whether smartphone prices will be affected.
n2e76b6782d.why: Apple is a major smartphone and chip-buying company, while Intel is a US chipmaker running large semiconductor manufacturing operations. Supply-chain shifts between them can affect chip costs and sourcing.

impacts.why: Apple agreed to work with Intel on designing and manufacturing its chips in the US.

n2e76b6782d.why_moved: Trump's statement that Apple will use Intel for US chip design and manufacturing is a direct partnership development for both companies.

n57d86199b6.headline: What's in the US-Iran deal? Key details from the 14-point agreement
n57d86199b6.summary: A 60-day countdown has started on a fragile truce as the United States and Iran work toward a final deal to end their war, according to details of a 14-point agreement.
n57d86199b6.why: A durable US-Iran settlement would affect Middle East risk premiums, oil flows and sanctions-exposed trade.

ne5ab0f4c11.headline: Commerce Commission approves $1.1 billion upgrade to the ageing Cook Strait power cables
ne5ab0f4c11.summary: The Commerce Commission approved Transpower's $1.1 billion plan to replace the ageing Cook Strait power cables and add a fourth. Inter-island capacity will rise to 1,400 megawatts.
ne5ab0f4c11.why: Transpower operates New Zealand's national grid, and Cook Strait cables carry power between the North and South Islands.

n5ab200b69d.headline: Vietnam’s Vingroup listed among 30 largest companies in Southeast Asia
n5ab200b69d.summary: Vingroup has secured a place among the 30 largest companies in Southeast Asia in the 2026 Fortune Southeast Asia 500 ranking. The ranking was released on Wednesday.
n5ab200b69d.why: Vingroup is Vietnam's largest private conglomerate, spanning real estate, retail, and automotive businesses.

n8532371df3.headline: Coalition's renewable energy buffer zones risks projects, report says
n8532371df3.summary: Energy experts have mixed views on the Victorian Coalition's proposed renewable energy buffer zone policy. The policy's effect on the state's energy transition is still debated.
n8532371df3.why: Buffer zone rules set where wind and solar projects can be built, which affects project pipelines and investment in renewable energy.

nbe4056a773.headline: Tokaido, Sanyo Shinkansen trains to have private compartments
nbe4056a773.summary: JR Tokai and JR West will start offering Supreme Class premium private compartments on their Shinkansen bullet trains from October 1. The announcement was made Wednesday.
nbe4056a773.why: JR Tokai and JR West are major Japanese rail operators, and premium services are a revenue lever for their high-speed networks.

nf3a98b003d.headline: Japan mulls plan to cut food tax rate to ‘virtually zero’ pct
nf3a98b003d.summary: The chair of a Japanese cross-party panel presented a proposal to lower the consumption tax on food to virtually zero percent. The plan would fulfil Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi's campaign pledge of a zero percent food tax rate.
nf3a98b003d.why: Consumption tax changes affect household spending, retail sales and public finances, which in turn influence Japanese government bond and equity markets.

n6e4ca5df06.headline: Waterways Leisure Tourism announces price band for its IPO opening on June 23
n6e4ca5df06.summary: Waterways Leisure Tourism, operator of Cordelia Cruises, set a price band of Rs 769-808 for its Rs 585 crore IPO opening June 23. Proceeds will support fleet-related lease payments and expansion plans.
n6e4ca5df06.why: An initial public offering lets a private company raise capital from public investors, and its pricing signals investor appetite for listed cruise and tourism businesses.

nb69873e798.headline: U.S. lifts blockade on Iranian ports as 60-day clock for a final deal starts ticking
nb69873e798.summary: The U.S. is allowing ships to enter and exit Iranian ports and coastal areas as both countries move to a new phase of negotiations over the next 60 days.
nb69873e798.why: Iranian ports and coastal areas handle oil and other trade flows, so changes to shipping access affect global energy and freight markets. A final deal could shift Iran's sanctions status.
nb69873e798.why_moved: Reopened Iranian ports and a defined 60-day negotiating window reduce near-term uncertainty over Gulf shipping and oil supply.

ne47fc089e6.headline: Labor identifies businesses to be exempt from new tax
ne47fc089e6.summary: Labor has identified the businesses to be exempt from a new tax, with strict criteria applied to small businesses seeking a 50 per cent discount on capital gains.
ne47fc089e6.why: Changes to capital gains tax treatment affect investment decisions and the valuation of small and medium business assets in Australia.

nccf450a194.headline: Ho Chi Minh City to transform 17 industrial parks into AI-powered smart industrial hubs
nccf450a194.summary: Ho Chi Minh City plans to transform 17 industrial parks and export processing zones into smart industrial hubs that use artificial intelligence and the Internet of Things.
nccf450a194.why: Industrial park upgrades shape Vietnam's manufacturing competitiveness and foreign direct investment, which matter for regional supply chains.

n495f9f3c3b.headline: BI hikes rate by 25 bps to stabilize rupiah amid global tensions
n495f9f3c3b.summary: Bank Indonesia raised its benchmark interest rate by 25 basis points to 5.75% to maintain rupiah stability amid global tensions. The move aims to support the currency.
n495f9f3c3b.why: Bank Indonesia sets the benchmark rate that influences Indonesian bond yields, borrowing costs and the rupiah's value.

n0370fbf2a2.headline: President Trump reveals Apple-Intel domestic partnership, boosting American chip stocks
n0370fbf2a2.summary: President Donald Trump announced that Apple has agreed to work with Intel to design and build its chips in America. The announcement boosted American chip stocks.
n0370fbf2a2.why: Apple is a major device maker that buys advanced chips, and Intel is a US chipmaker building foundry capacity, so the partnership affects both companies' chip strategies.

impacts.name: Intel
impacts.why: The announced chip design and manufacturing partnership with Apple is a direct business win for Intel.

impacts.name: Apple
impacts.why: Apple is the partner agreeing to design and build chips with Intel in America.

n0370fbf2a2.why_moved: Trump's announcement of an Apple-Intel domestic chip partnership lifted American chip stocks, per the report.

nfaa6113d1d.headline: L’Oréal acquires majority stake in Innovist as global giants double down on India | Company Business News
nfaa6113d1d.summary: L'Oréal has acquired a majority stake in Innovist, with founders Rohit Chawla, Sifat Khurana and Vimal Bhola retaining minority stakes. They will continue to run the business alongside L'Oréal India.
nfaa6113d1d.why: L'Oréal is the world's largest cosmetics group, and it is expanding in India's fast-growing beauty market.

n699fc5535a.headline: THACO targets April 2027 start for metro railcar production for Ho Chi Minh City rail projects
n699fc5535a.summary: Vietnamese conglomerate THACO plans to begin railcar production in April 2027 at a new factory to supply metro and railway projects, including the Ho Chi Minh City to Long Thanh airport line.
n699fc5535a.why: THACO is one of Vietnam's largest conglomerates, with interests in automotive manufacturing, and its rail output would feed the country's major urban transport build-out.

n97567c4841.headline: BI sees stable growth despite 100-basis-point rate hike
n97567c4841.summary: Bank Indonesia Governor Perry Warjiyo said economic growth remains stable, supported by resilient domestic demand, despite a 100-basis-point rate increase.
n97567c4841.why: Bank Indonesia sets the country's policy rate, which influences the rupiah, government bond yields and domestic borrowing costs.
n97567c4841.why_moved: The central bank's 100-basis-point rate hike and its message about stable growth shape expectations for rates and the currency.

na7575a0bb9.headline: US is ‘honouring’ Iran deal as oil flows through Strait of Hormuz – Vance
na7575a0bb9.summary: Vice President JD Vance said more than 12.5 million barrels of oil passed through the Strait of Hormuz on Wednesday night. He said the US is honouring the Iran deal.
na7575a0bb9.why: The Strait of Hormuz is one of the world's most important oil chokepoints, so disruptions there directly affect global crude supply and prices.
na7575a0bb9.why_moved: Oil flows through the Strait of Hormuz resumed under the Iran deal, which eases supply risk for crude transiting the waterway.

nac71c72ee4.headline: Top Senate Republican rips into Trump's Iran deal, says $300B makes Obama deal look like 'a pittance'
nac71c72ee4.summary: Senate Armed Services Chair Roger Wicker said the Iran deal negotiates away US victories. He warned the $300 billion fund dwarfs Obama's 2015 agreement.
nac71c72ee4.why: Congressional oversight can shape the durability of US sanctions policy and international agreements, which in turn affects oil and financial markets.

nb4fc1778e8.headline: UK removes ‘do not travel’ warnings for Dubai and several Middle Eastern countries
nb4fc1778e8.summary: The UK has lifted 'do not travel' warnings for Dubai, Abu Dhabi and several other Middle Eastern countries, potentially allowing holidays to resume this year.
nb4fc1778e8.why: Travel advisories shape tourism demand, airline routes and hotel bookings, which are major revenue sources for Gulf economies such as the UAE.

n349c73d361.headline: Palm oil stocks set to surge as Indonesia said to be scaling back export overhaul: analysts
n349c73d361.summary: Analysts say Indonesia is scaling back its export overhaul, and brokerages including UOBKH and RHB are moving to upgrade battered plantation stocks. The report was published by The Business Times.
n349c73d361.why: Indonesia and Malaysia are the world's largest palm oil producers, so export rules there shape global vegetable oil supply and prices. Plantation companies are sensitive to these policies.

n7e35199780.headline: Malaysian data centres test lenders | IFR
n7e35199780.summary: Malaysian data centre developers are returning to lenders to fund the next phase of buildout, but face wary banks. The report is from IFR.
n7e35199780.why: Data centres require large debt financing, and lender appetite shapes how fast cloud and AI infrastructure can expand in Southeast Asia.

nb478776015.headline: Europe tries to take on China without launching a new trade war
nb478776015.summary: Europe is trying to take on China without launching a new trade war, with China's economy described as highly dependent on exports and weak domestic demand.
nb478776015.why: Trade tensions between the EU and China affect exporters, supply chains and tariff-exposed sectors on both sides.

nc0b8762757.headline: Indonesia, Philippines set to hike rates as caution prevails: Bloomberg survey
nc0b8762757.summary: A Bloomberg survey shows Indonesia and the Philippines set to hike interest rates as caution prevails. Both economies have been hit by the steep increase in global oil prices.
nc0b8762757.why: Central bank rate decisions drive local bond yields and currencies, and oil prices feed directly into inflation in import-dependent economies.

n18634eadf0.headline: China seeks to curb ‘unfair’ competition in food delivery sector
n18634eadf0.summary: Beijing is proposing draft regulations targeting subsidy campaigns by platform operators that artificially reduce prices and encourage more orders in the food delivery sector.
n18634eadf0.why: Food delivery platforms in China are large, competitive businesses, and subsidy wars have heavily affected their margins and profitability.

nc731bc0b29.headline: Japan intervention risk mounts as yen drops to lowest since 2024
nc731bc0b29.summary: The yen has fallen to its lowest level since 2024 and intervention risk is mounting. The currency has been under pressure from the wide interest-rate gap between the US and Japan.
nc731bc0b29.why: The yen is a major currency, and Japanese authorities can intervene in FX markets, which can move USD/JPY sharply.
nc731bc0b29.why_moved: A wide interest-rate gap between the US and Japan has kept pressure on the yen, raising the prospect of Japanese authorities intervening.

n242e4fe09e.headline: Iran announces plans to bring in maritime fees for strait of Hormuz
n242e4fe09e.summary: Iran says fees to cover the cost of managing the strait will take effect at the end of a 60-day negotiation period, as the US lifts its blockade. The strait is a key route for global oil shipments.
n242e4fe09e.why: The Strait of Hormuz is a critical chokepoint through which a large share of seaborne oil passes, so changes to transit costs or access affect energy markets.

nd735dd7d06.headline: BSP hikes rates anew on inflation pressure
nd735dd7d06.summary: The Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas raised its benchmark rate for a second straight meeting as inflation pressures spread. It signalled future moves would likely stay measured unless second-round effects worsen.
nd735dd7d06.why: The Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas sets the Philippines' benchmark policy rate, which influences borrowing costs, bond yields and the peso.
nd735dd7d06.why_moved: The central bank raised rates for a second straight meeting as inflation pressures broadened.

nf98f1364b8.headline: Big Petrol Price cut under Consideration as PM orders relief plan
nf98f1364b8.summary: The Pakistani government is considering a cut of more than Rs55 per litre in petroleum product prices after a sharp decline in international crude oil prices. The PM has ordered a relief plan.
nf98f1364b8.why: Pakistan regularly adjusts domestic fuel prices in line with global crude costs, which feeds into inflation and household budgets.

nbc64a8398f.headline: Electronic tax return filing made mandatory under new proposal
nbc64a8398f.summary: Pakistan's National Assembly Standing Committee on Finance approved a proposal requiring income tax returns to be filed exclusively through electronic means. The measure still needs further approval.
nbc64a8398f.why: Tax filing rules shape compliance costs and government revenue collection, which matter for businesses and fiscal policy.

nee38984e8b.headline: National Assembly finance committee approves tax on social media income
nee38984e8b.summary: Pakistan's National Assembly Finance Committee approved a proposal to impose tax on income generated from social media. The measure is intended for the upcoming fiscal year.
nee38984e8b.why: New income tax rules for digital earnings affect creators, platforms and government revenue.

n488d86282f.headline: Freeze on adjustments in InstaPay, PESONet  transfer fees lifted
n488d86282f.summary: The moratorium on fee increases for InstaPay and PESONet transactions has been lifted. Payment providers can now adjust charges under a new pricing framework for electronic fund transfers.
n488d86282f.why: InstaPay and PESONet are Philippine real-time and batch electronic payment systems, and fee rules affect payment providers and consumers.
